title: Why I’m Thankful to Teach English
channel: Speak English with Bo's Slow English

lines.text: Hello everyone. Welcome to a new episode
of Bose's Slow English. Normally I speak
in slow English, but in today's episode
I'll be speaking in more of my normal
speed. I've been receiving a lot of
requests from my subscribers to speak in
this normal speed. So I hope that this
video is a bit of a challenge for you,
but at the same time, I hope you are
able to comprehend it. Today is a
national holiday. It's called
Thanksgiving. And on Thanksgiving, we
are supposed to express our gratitude
for the things and the people that we
love and that we are grateful for. I
hope you learned some new vocabulary
today and please like this video. Share
this with any of your friends who are
also learning English. And if you're
interested in continuing your English
journey with me, check out my ebooks.
The link is in the description below.
There are so many things to be grateful
for. First of all, I am grateful to have
a roof over my head. I am grateful for
water and food, and I'm grateful for all
the simple and necessary things that
give me life. Of course, I am super
grateful for you for supporting my
channel. I really mean it. Today, I hit
90,000 subscribers.
I did slow down a little bit with the
number of postings this month, so I was
actually surprised that I was able to
meet my goal of 90,000 subscribers. Part
of the reason why I slowed down with the
number of videos that I've posted is
because I didn't want to get burned out

to burn out? To burn out means that you
work so hard that you have a lot of
stress and it's not enjoyable anymore. I
started my YouTube channel to have some
sort of passion project, which is
another word for hobby. There was quite
a few months where I would come home

this literally every single day for at
least 3 months. that was not becoming
sustainable, which means that I couldn't
keep it going. So, I decided to scale
back a little bit, which means that I'm
not posting every single day. I'm still
posting on a regular basis, but when I
do post now, I feel that the videos that
I'm posting now have a greater quality
to it. So, instead of focusing on
quantity, I'm focusing on quality. I
read every single comment that you post,
